items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Week 7 vs CIN. Status crucial for DFS main slate; early news hoped for.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury dump; Schefter confirms official Q listing; Rapoport notes positive comments ('headed in right direction').
items.implication: If OUT, Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and Henry/Andrews/Likely impacted. If ACTIVE, full Lamar upside vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Monitor pregame; beneficiaries if OUT include Huntley and Ravens skill if volume shifts.

items.text: Puka Nacua QUESTIONABLE (calf); will test pregame. Missed Friday practice after limited Thursday; McVay notes lack of power/explosion.
items.why: ETR dump + McVay comments via beat; Rapoport: minor calf, up-in-air/pregame test. Schefter notes Q.
items.implication: Game-time; Adams already IR. If OUT, heavy TE usage (Higbee #1 target hierarchy per Levitan).
items.opportunity: Tyler Higbee primary beneficiary (routes/targets/RZ); also Konata Mumpfield, Parkinson, Atwell.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) for Week 7 vs MIA. Crucial DFS status.
items.why: ETR Sunday list; Berry loves if active vs Dolphins.
items.implication: If ACTIVE, start immediately (Berry); if OUT, Allen/committee elevated in good matchup.
items.opportunity: Full workload if clears; monitor for snap share return.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel ruled OUT for 49ers vs ATL (Evans Achilles; Deebo hamstring). Confirmed by Shanahan/Rapoport and ETR.
items.why: Official team ruling + Schefter list + Rapoport coach confirm + ETR dump.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps decimated; massive funnel to Kittle and CMC (slot temptation).
items.opportunity: George Kittle WR-out funnel (Levitan: scheme + injuries = nuts); CMC more slot/receiving; Christian Kirk elevated.

items.text: Brian Robinson ruled OUT (hamstring) Week 7. ETR and Levitan highlight as sneaky important scratch.
items.why: Schefter OUT list; Levitan notes 49ers D inflates opposing RB (4.4% above baseline, recent RB catches/TDs).
items.implication: Full Bijan Robinson workload + receiving vs soft SF DvP.
items.opportunity: Bijan full bellcow + pass-game upside in sweet matchup.

items.text: LOVE Saquon Barkley if active vs DAL (efficient prior, great RB matchup); LOVE Breece Hall if active vs MIA (start immediately despite some caution).
items.why: Berry Love/Hate + Pregame; Saquon 'in line' to play MNF.
items.implication: Must-start RB1/2 if cleared; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Full roles in plus matchups (DAL soft vs RB; MIA).

items.text: Zach Charbonnet ruled OUT for Seahawks vs KC (SNF).
items.implication: Kenneth Walker or backups (Wilson/Holani) elevated carries/snaps.
items.opportunity: Walker III clear lead if healthy; handcuff value spikes.

items.text: If Puka OUT, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc. Adams already out long-term.
items.why: Levitan player-specific hierarchy from McVay context + prior Adams-out TE share data (Berry: 37% TE ts when Puka out).
items.implication: Higbee TE1 upside; Rams multi-TE heavy.
items.opportunity: Higbee routes/targets/RZ primary; stash Ferguson for later.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK/LOVE with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR PPG, 6+ rec and 60+ yards in both games since return.
items.why: Berry per-player Love with usage stats; Kmet IR further helps.
items.opportunity: High target share sustained; start with confidence.

items.text: Bijan full opportunity + SF DvP (inflates RB by 4.4%, recent RB catches/TDs to White/Holani/Harvey/Love) with Brian Robinson OUT.
items.why: Levitan data on SF conceding to RBs + BRob OUT confirmation.
items.opportunity: Bellcow + receiving work vs soft matchup.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: awesome player/scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Ignore National TE Day narrative.
items.why: Levitan opportunity-first: WR injuries create funnel.
items.opportunity: Massive target/route share increase; CMC slot temptation secondary.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet to IR with season-ending knee injury (carted off TNF). Coach Ben Johnson confirms.
items.why: Rapoport sources + coach confirm; Schefter notes IR.
items.implication: Reduces 2/3-TE sets; more 11 personnel juice for Burden/Odunze/Loveland.
items.opportunity: Luther Burden elite YPRR (2.56) + higher route rate; Loveland already 30% ts/19.2 PPR with Caleb (Berry).

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks. Concerning usage.
items.implication: Not a reliable every-week starter; committee/backup role.
items.opportunity: Low opportunity; monitor for change but currently buried.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.implication: Higher snap/route rate upside with Caleb.
items.opportunity: Breakout potential via efficiency + volume bump.
